name: data-presentation
description: Turn structured data an agent already holds into something a person can actually read in a chat transcript. Picks the form the data earns - a Markdown table by default, a line chart when the shape is worth a picture - validates the values, renders, checks its own output, and reports what it left out. It never invents a missing value and never claims more than the data supports. It does not fetch data and does not interpret what the numbers mean.
